name: Volve
holds: Daily and monthly production for every well in Equinor's Volve field, from first oil to shutdown.
about: Volve is a small oil field in the Norwegian North Sea. Equinor produced it from first oil until it was shut down, then released the field's data for research and teaching. PetroDB republishes the production reports as three tables that join on one key, npd_wellbore_code: one row per well in wells, one per well per day in daily_production, and one per well per month in monthly_production.

The daily table carries more than volumes: hours on stream, downhole and wellhead pressures and temperatures, and choke opening. Some wells switched from producing oil to injecting water, so flow_kind and well_type are recorded per day. The schema document explains each column.

units.unit: hours on stream in the day (daily) or the month (monthly)

queries.title: One well's daily history
queries.why: Wells are named in the small wells table. Join it to the daily table to pick a well by name instead of by its NPD code.
queries.sql:
SELECT d.date, d.on_stream_hours, d.oil_volume, d.gas_volume, d.water_volume
FROM '{base}/volve/daily_production.parquet' AS d
JOIN '{base}/volve/wells.parquet' AS w USING (npd_wellbore_code)
WHERE w.wellbore_name = '15/9-F-12'   -- the field's biggest producer
ORDER BY d.date;
queries.polars:
import polars as pl

daily = pl.scan_parquet("{base}/volve/daily_production.parquet")
wells = pl.scan_parquet("{base}/volve/wells.parquet")

well = (
    daily.join(wells, on="npd_wellbore_code")
    .filter(pl.col("wellbore_name") == "15/9-F-12")   # the field's biggest producer
    .select("date", "on_stream_hours", "oil_volume", "gas_volume", "water_volume")
    .sort("date")
    .collect()
)

queries.title: Pressures while a well was flowing
queries.why: Pressure and temperature readings are missing on many days. Keep the days the well was on stream and had a downhole reading.
queries.sql:
SELECT d.date,
       d.avg_downhole_pressure,
       d.avg_wellhead_pressure,
       d.avg_choke_size_percent
FROM '{base}/volve/daily_production.parquet' AS d
JOIN '{base}/volve/wells.parquet' AS w USING (npd_wellbore_code)
WHERE w.wellbore_name = '15/9-F-14'
  AND d.on_stream_hours > 0
  AND d.avg_downhole_pressure > 0
ORDER BY d.date;
queries.polars:
import polars as pl

daily = pl.scan_parquet("{base}/volve/daily_production.parquet")
wells = pl.scan_parquet("{base}/volve/wells.parquet")

pressures = (
    daily.join(wells, on="npd_wellbore_code")
    .filter(
        (pl.col("wellbore_name") == "15/9-F-14")
        & (pl.col("on_stream_hours") > 0)
        & (pl.col("avg_downhole_pressure") > 0)
    )
    .select("date", "avg_downhole_pressure", "avg_wellhead_pressure", "avg_choke_size_percent")
    .sort("date")
    .collect()
)

queries.title: A year of monthly volumes, well by well
queries.why: The monthly table is Equinor's own monthly report, with gas and water injection alongside production. Its date is the first day of each month.
queries.sql:
SELECT w.wellbore_name,
       m.date AS month,
       m.oil_volume_sm3,
       m.gas_volume_sm3,
       m.water_volume_sm3,
       m.water_injection_sm3
FROM '{base}/volve/monthly_production.parquet' AS m
JOIN '{base}/volve/wells.parquet' AS w USING (npd_wellbore_code)
WHERE m.date >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND m.date < DATE '2015-01-01'
ORDER BY w.wellbore_name, month;
queries.polars:
from datetime import datetime

import polars as pl

monthly = pl.scan_parquet("{base}/volve/monthly_production.parquet")
wells = pl.scan_parquet("{base}/volve/wells.parquet")

year = (
    monthly.join(wells, on="npd_wellbore_code")
    .filter(pl.col("date").is_between(datetime(2014, 1, 1), datetime(2015, 1, 1), closed="left"))
    .select(
        "wellbore_name",
        pl.col("date").alias("month"),
        "oil_volume_sm3",
        "gas_volume_sm3",
        "water_volume_sm3",
        "water_injection_sm3",
    )
    .sort("wellbore_name", "month")
    .collect()
)

source.text: Production data from the Volve data village, which Equinor released in 2018 together with the field's subsurface and operations data. PetroDB uses the daily and monthly sheets of Volve production data.xlsx.
